decisions.reason: The IMU sensor module sits close to the firm's existing sensor bricklets, and its own R&D lets the firm interpret early feedback and refine the module within its modular system.
The industrial AC voltage input module extends the firm's industrial input product line, and its dedicated page signals active commitment backed by in-house hardware and firmware expertise.
The four-channel solid state relay module closely matches the firm's existing relay and control modules, so it can be assimilated and improved at low cost.
The server room monitoring kit bundles existing sensor modules and builds on established knowledge, though kits are more easily rearranged or replaced as the platform moves to newer connectors.
